page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with the printed lines in a single block. No margins or notes. The scan shows the text reversed and faint, so several lines are uncertain.
page.notes: The scan shows this title page reversed and faint, with show-through from the other side. Only the large words are clear. The lines marked as illegible could not be read letter by letter. The woodcut or engraving at the centre is not transcribed. The library stamp at the foot and the blue ink stamp are left out.
